PipeLakitu2.name: Pipe Lakitu tiles, Baby Yoshi helpers
summary: Lower-half tile table for the Pipe Lakitu, the tail of its draw routine, and three Baby Yoshi helpers called from bank 01.
$02E9EC: draws the two-tile Pipe Lakitu. $02EA25: Baby Yoshi draw tail, sets the dynamic tile source in $0D8B/$0D95 (probably).
$02EA4E: Baby Yoshi scans the other sprites to find one to put in its mouth ([$160E]). Interpretation of the tweaker tests is a guess.

WarpBlocksMain.name: Warp hole sprite and Feather spawn
summary: $02EAD2: main routine of sprite $8E (invisible warp hole block): when Mario touches it his X speed is zeroed and he is centred on it.
$02EAF2: spawns a Feather ($77) at the current sprite with Y speed $D0; called from the bank 01 sprite kill code for sprites $72 and up.

SuperKoopaMain.name: Super Koopa main wrapper
summary: Long entry for the red, yellow and feather Super Koopa ($71-$73): sets the data bank and runs the routine at $02EB31.

s02EB2F.name: Table: Super Koopa flight X speed
summary: Indexed by direction: $18 (right), $E8 (left).

s02EB31.name: Super Koopa behaviour
summary: Draws the sprite, then handles the killed tumble (status 2), movement and interaction. The feather Super Koopa ($73) runs a three state machine instead of flying straight.

SuperKoopaPtrs.name: Feather Super Koopa state machine
summary: Pointers: state 0 = swoop and accelerate, 1 = rise, 2 = fly at constant speed. Followed by target X speed and acceleration tables.
Quirk: [$01] = [$13] AND $00 is always 0, so the speed is raised every frame.

s02EC06.name: Table: Super Koopa tile X offsets
summary: 9 frames x 4 tiles = 36 bytes, then 36 more for the mirrored direction (index + $24).

s02EC4E.name: Table: Super Koopa tile Y offsets
summary: 9 frames x 4 tiles.

SuperKoopaTiles.name: Super Koopa tiles, properties, sizes and draw
summary: Tile number table (9 frames x 4), tile property table (bit 1 marks the cape tile), OAM size table, and the draw routine at $02ECDE.
Draw: four tiles per frame, mirrored X offsets and X flip when the direction bit is clear, cape palette chosen by sprite number ($71 red, others yellow) or flashing if [$1534] is set.

s02ED39.name: Table: Super Koopa flashing cape palettes
summary: $10, $0A, alternated every 2 frames.

s02ED3B.name: Super Koopa cape palette and OAM finish
summary: Continuation of the draw routine: picks the cape colour, builds the OAM property byte, stores X, and loops over the four tiles.

s02ED7F.name: Table: floating skull X offsets
summary: $10, $20, $30: positions of the three skulls spawned next to the first.

FloatingSkullInit.name: Floating skull raft init
summary: Resets the shared raft speed [$18BC], sets the state and spawns three more floating skulls ($61) to the right (+$10, +$20, +$30), forming a four-skull raft.

FloatingSkullMain.name: Floating skull raft main
summary: Draws the skull (tile alternates $E0/$E2), applies the shared raft speed [$18BC], and carries Mario when he lands on it, which sets the speed to $0C.
When one skull dies all the others are erased. [$00] (contact flags of other skulls) is computed but not used in this routine.

CoinCloudMain.name: Coin game cloud wrapper
summary: Long entry for sprite $6A: sets the data bank and runs ADDR_02EEB5.

s02EEB1.name: Table: coin cloud Y acceleration and limit
summary: $02EEB1: acceleration +1/-1. $02EEB3: maximum Y speed $10/$F0.

s02EEB5.name: Coin game cloud behaviour
summary: Every $80 frames drops a cloud game coin (extended sprite $0A) or, once [$18E3] reaches $0A, a 1-Up ($78); up to $0B times.
The cloud bobs around Y = $0110, moves right at speed 8, and flies away when finished. Draws the cloud plus a second tile.

s02EFEA.name: Table: Wiggler buffer offsets
summary: $02EFEA: low bytes $00,$80,$00,$80; $02EFEE: high bytes $00,$00,$01,$01. Offset of the position history per sprite slot AND 3.

WigglerInit.name: Wiggler init
summary: Fills the Wiggler's 64-entry position history (X, Y pairs at $7F:9A7B + (slot AND 3) * $80) with its spawn position and faces Mario.

WigglerMain.name: Wiggler main wrapper
summary: Long entry: sets the data bank and runs WigglerMainRt.

WigglerSpeed.name: Table: Wiggler X speeds
summary: $08,$F8 normal; $10,$F0 angry.
